summary: This bill expands the E-3 nonimmigrant visa program, which allows foreign nationals to work in specialty occupations, to include Irish citizens, requiring their employers to participate in the E-Verify program and allocating available visas between Australian and Irish nationals.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the E-3 nonimmigrant visa program to include Irish nationals, allowing more individuals from Ireland to work in the U.S. under specific professional categories. While it doesn't increase the total number of E-3 visas, it reallocates existing slots to include Irish citizens, thus facilitating more immigration from Ireland.
